en-US.author: KDE e.V.
en-US.longDescription: KBlocks is the classic falling blocks game. The idea is to stack the falling blocks to create horizontal lines without any gaps. When a line is completed it is removed, and more space is available in the play area. When there is not enough space for blocks to fall, the game is over.
en-US.name: kblocks

zh-CN.longDescription: KBlocks 是一款经典的俄罗斯方块游戏。游戏玩法是堆叠下落的方块，并使一行填满方块。一行填满后，这行方块就会清空，给游戏区域腾出更多空间。当没有足够的空间让方块下落时，游戏结束。
